        $characterLength = \PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Shared\StringHelper::countCharacters($preparedFormula);
        $scannedFunctions = [];
        $regexFunctions = [];
        $functionCatalog = [];
        $tokenCount = 0;
        $hasDateTimeFunction = false;
        $hasDynamicArrayFunction = false;
        $hasLegacyFunction = false;
        $hasWorksheetPrefixedFunction = false;
        $inString = false;
        $inPath = false;
        $inRange = false;
        $inError = false;
        $scanIndex = 0;
        $scanValue = '';
        $errorBuffer = '';
        $parenDepth = 0;
        $errorTokens = ['#NULL!', '#DIV/0!', '#VALUE!', '#REF!', '#NAME?', '#NUM!', '#N/A'];
        $comparatorTokens = ['>=', '<=', '<>'];
        $dateFunctionNames = [
            'DAYS' => true,
            'NETWORKDAYS' => true,
            'NETWORKDAYS.INTL' => true,
            'TODAY' => true,
            'DATE' => true,
            'EDATE' => true,
            'EOMONTH' => true,
        ];
        $dynamicFunctionNames = [
            'FILTER' => true,
            'SORT' => true,
            'SORTBY' => true,
            'UNIQUE' => true,
            'SEQUENCE' => true,
            'RANDARRAY' => true,
            'XLOOKUP' => true,
            'XMATCH' => true,
        ];
        $legacyFunctionNames = [
            'SUM' => true,
            'ABS' => true,
            'IF' => true,
            'DATE' => true,
            'TODAY' => true,
        ];

                    $functionCatalog = \PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Calculation\Calculation::getFunctions();

                    }
                    $parser = new \PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Calculation\FormulaParser($parseableFormula);
                    $tokenCount = $parser->getTokenCount();
                    $parsedFormula = $parser->getFormula();
                    if ($parsedFormula === '') {
                        $parsedFormula = $parseableFormula;
                    }

                    $functionPattern = '/' . \PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Calculation\Calculation::CALCULATION_REGEXP_FUNCTION . '/ui';
                    $regexCount = preg_match_all($functionPattern, $preparedFormula, $regexCaptures, PREG_SET_ORDER | PREG_OFFSET_CAPTURE);
                    if ($regexCount) {
                        foreach ($regexCaptures as $regexCapture) {
                            if (isset($regexCapture[1][0])) {
                                $regexFunctions[] = $regexCapture[1][0];
                            }
                        }

                        $character = $preparedFormula[$scanIndex];
                        if ($inString) {

                                if (($scanIndex + 1) < $byteLength) {
                                    if ($preparedFormula[$scanIndex + 1] === \PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Calculation\FormulaParser::QUOTE_DOUBLE) {
                                        $scanValue .= \PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Calculation\FormulaParser::QUOTE_DOUBLE;
                                        ++$scanIndex;
                                    } else {
                                        $inString = false;
                                        $scanValue = '';
                                    }
                                } else {
                                    $inString = false;
                                    $scanValue = '';
                                }
                            } else {
                                $scanValue .= $character;
                            }
                            ++$scanIndex;

                            continue;
                        }
                        if ($inPath) {
                            if ($character === \PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Calculation\FormulaParser::QUOTE_SINGLE) {
                                if (($scanIndex + 1) < $byteLength) {
                                    if ($preparedFormula[$scanIndex + 1] === \PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Calculation\FormulaParser::QUOTE_SINGLE) {
                                        $scanValue .= \PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Calculation\FormulaParser::QUOTE_SINGLE;
                                        ++$scanIndex;
                                    } else {
                                        $inPath = false;
                                    }
                                } else {
                                    $inPath = false;
                                }
                            } else {
                                $scanValue .= $character;
                            }
                            ++$scanIndex;

                            continue;
                        }
                        if ($inRange) {
                            if ($character === \PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Calculation\FormulaParser::BRACKET_CLOSE) {
                                $inRange = false;
                            }
                            $scanValue .= $character;
                            ++$scanIndex;

                            continue;
                        }
                        if ($inError) {
                            $errorBuffer .= $character;
                            if (in_array($errorBuffer, $errorTokens, true)) {
                                $inError = false;
                                $errorBuffer = '';
                                $scanValue = '';
                            }
                            ++$scanIndex;

                            continue;
                        }
                        if ($character === \PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Calculation\FormulaParser::QUOTE_DOUBLE) {
                            $inString = true;
                            $scanValue = '';
                            ++$scanIndex;

                            continue;
                        }
                        if ($character === \PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Calculation\FormulaParser::QUOTE_SINGLE) {
                            $inPath = true;
                            ++$scanIndex;

                            continue;
                        }
                        if ($character === \PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Calculation\FormulaParser::BRACKET_OPEN) {
                            $inRange = true;
                            $scanValue .= $character;
                            ++$scanIndex;

                            continue;
                        }
                        if ($character === \PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Calculation\FormulaParser::ERROR_START) {
                            $inError = true;
                            $errorBuffer = $character;
                            $scanValue = '';
                            ++$scanIndex;

                            continue;
                        }
                        if ($character === \PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Calculation\FormulaParser::PAREN_OPEN) {
                            if ($scanValue !== '') {
                                $scannedFunctions[] = $scanValue;
                                $upperScan = \PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Shared\StringHelper::strToUpper($scanValue);
                                if (strpos($upperScan, '_XLWS.') !== false) {
                                    $hasWorksheetPrefixedFunction = true;
                                }
                                if (strpos($upperScan, '_XLFN.') !== false) {
                                    $hasWorksheetPrefixedFunction = true;
                                }

                            $scanValue = '';
                            ++$parenDepth;
                            ++$scanIndex;

                            continue;

                        if ($character === \PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Calculation\FormulaParser::PAREN_CLOSE) {
                            $scanValue = '';
                            if ($parenDepth > 0) {

                            }
                            ++$scanIndex;

                            continue;
                        }
                        if ($character === \PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Calculation\FormulaParser::COMMA) {
                            $scanValue = '';
                            ++$scanIndex;

                            continue;
                        }
                        if ($character === \PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Calculation\FormulaParser::BRACE_OPEN) {
                            $scanValue = '';
                            ++$scanIndex;

                            continue;
                        }
                        if ($character === \PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Calculation\FormulaParser::BRACE_CLOSE) {
                            $scanValue = '';
                            ++$scanIndex;

                            continue;
                        }
                        if ($character === \PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Calculation\FormulaParser::WHITESPACE) {
                            $scanValue = '';
                            ++$scanIndex;
                            while ($scanIndex < $byteLength) {
                                if ($preparedFormula[$scanIndex] !== \PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Calculation\FormulaParser::WHITESPACE) {

                            }

                            continue;

                        if (($scanIndex + 2) <= $byteLength) {
                            $pair = substr($preparedFormula, $scanIndex, 2);
                            if (in_array($pair, $comparatorTokens, true)) {
                                $scanValue = '';

                                continue;
                            }
                        }
                        if (strpos(\PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Calculation\FormulaParser::OPERATORS_INFIX, $character) !== false) {
                            $scanValue = '';
                            ++$scanIndex;

                            continue;
                        }
                        if (strpos(\PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Calculation\FormulaParser::OPERATORS_POSTFIX, $character) !== false) {
                            $scanValue = '';
                            ++$scanIndex;

                            continue;
                        }
                        if (strpos('ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789._', $character) !== false) {
                            $scanValue .= $character;
                            ++$scanIndex;

                            continue;
                        }
                        $scanValue = '';
                        ++$scanIndex;
                    }

                    $classifiedNames = array_merge($scannedFunctions, $regexFunctions);
                    foreach ($classifiedNames as $rawName) {
                        $trimmedName = trim((string) $rawName);
                        if ($trimmedName === '') {
                            continue;
                        }
                        $normalizedName = \PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Shared\StringHelper::strToUpper($trimmedName);
                        $normalizedName = str_replace('_XLFN.', '', $normalizedName);
                        $normalizedName = str_replace('_XLWS.', '', $normalizedName);
                        if (isset($functionCatalog[$normalizedName])) {
                            $category = '';
                            if (isset($functionCatalog[$normalizedName]['category'])) {
                                $category = $functionCatalog[$normalizedName]['category'];
                            }
                            if ($category === 'Date and Time') {
                                $hasDateTimeFunction = true;
                                if (isset($dateFunctionNames[$normalizedName])) {
                                    if ($normalizedName === 'NETWORKDAYS') {
                                        $hasDateTimeFunction = true;
                                    } elseif ($normalizedName === 'DAYS') {
                                        $hasDateTimeFunction = true;
                                    } else {
                                        $hasLegacyFunction = true;
                                    }
                                }
                            } elseif ($category === 'Lookup and Reference') {
                                if (isset($dynamicFunctionNames[$normalizedName])) {
                                    $hasDynamicArrayFunction = true;
                                } else {
                                    $hasLegacyFunction = true;
                                }
                            } elseif ($category === 'Math and Trig') {
                                if (isset($legacyFunctionNames[$normalizedName])) {
                                    $hasLegacyFunction = true;
                                }
                            } elseif ($category === 'Logical') {
                                if (isset($legacyFunctionNames[$normalizedName])) {
                                    $hasLegacyFunction = true;
                                }
                            }
                        } else {
                            if (isset($dynamicFunctionNames[$normalizedName])) {
                                $hasDynamicArrayFunction = true;
                            } elseif (strpos($normalizedName, 'DAYS') !== false) {
                                $hasDateTimeFunction = true;
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    $prefixed = $preparedFormula;
                    $xlfnCount = preg_match_all(self::XLFNREGEXP, $prefixed, $xlfnCaptures, PREG_SET_ORDER | PREG_OFFSET_CAPTURE);
                    if ($xlfnCount) {
                        for ($xlfnIndex = $xlfnCount - 1; $xlfnIndex >= 0; --$xlfnIndex) {
                            if (isset($xlfnCaptures[$xlfnIndex][0][0], $xlfnCaptures[$xlfnIndex][0][1], $xlfnCaptures[$xlfnIndex][1][0])) {
                                $fullMatch = $xlfnCaptures[$xlfnIndex][0][0];
                                $fullOffset = (int) $xlfnCaptures[$xlfnIndex][0][1];
                                $innerName = $xlfnCaptures[$xlfnIndex][1][0];
                                $lookupName = \PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Shared\StringHelper::strToUpper($innerName);
                                $lookupName = str_replace('_XLWS.', '', $lookupName);
                                if (isset($functionCatalog[$lookupName])) {
                                    $matchCategory = '';
                                    if (isset($functionCatalog[$lookupName]['category'])) {
                                        $matchCategory = $functionCatalog[$lookupName]['category'];
                                    }
                                    if ($matchCategory === 'Date and Time') {
                                        $hasDateTimeFunction = true;
                                    } elseif ($matchCategory === 'Lookup and Reference') {
                                        $hasDynamicArrayFunction = true;
                                    } else {
                                        $hasLegacyFunction = $hasLegacyFunction || isset($legacyFunctionNames[$lookupName]);
                                    }
                                } elseif ($lookupName === 'DAYS') {
                                    $hasDateTimeFunction = true;
                                }
                                $replacement = '_xlfn.' . $innerName . '(';
                                if ($fullOffset >= 0) {
                                    if ($fullOffset <= strlen($prefixed)) {
                                        $prefixed = substr($prefixed, 0, $fullOffset) . $replacement . substr($prefixed, $fullOffset + strlen($fullMatch));
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    $xlwsCount = preg_match_all(self::XLWSREGEXP, $prefixed, $xlwsCaptures, PREG_SET_ORDER | PREG_OFFSET_CAPTURE);
                    if ($xlwsCount) {
                        for ($xlwsIndex = $xlwsCount - 1; $xlwsIndex >= 0; --$xlwsIndex) {
                            if (isset($xlwsCaptures[$xlwsIndex][0][0], $xlwsCaptures[$xlwsIndex][0][1], $xlwsCaptures[$xlwsIndex][1][0])) {
                                $wsMatch = $xlwsCaptures[$xlwsIndex][0][0];
                                $wsOffset = (int) $xlwsCaptures[$xlwsIndex][0][1];
                                $wsInner = $xlwsCaptures[$xlwsIndex][1][0];
                                $wsLookup = \PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Shared\StringHelper::strToUpper($wsInner);
                                if ($wsLookup === 'FILTER') {
                                    $hasDynamicArrayFunction = true;
                                } elseif ($wsLookup === 'SORT') {
                                    $hasDynamicArrayFunction = true;
                                }
                                $wsReplacement = '_xlws.' . $wsInner . '(';
                                if ($wsOffset >= 0) {
                                    if ($wsOffset <= strlen($prefixed)) {
                                        $prefixed = substr($prefixed, 0, $wsOffset) . $wsReplacement . substr($prefixed, $wsOffset + strlen($wsMatch));
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    return $prefixed;
                } catch (\Throwable $throwable) {
                    return self::addXlwsPrefix(self::addXlfnPrefix($functionString));
                }
            }
        }

        return self::addXlwsPrefix(self::addXlfnPrefix($functionString));
    }

    /**
     * Prefix function name in string with _xlfn. where required.
     * Leading character, expected to be equals sign, is stripped.
     */
    public static function addFunctionPrefixStripEquals(string $functionString): string
    {
        return self::addFunctionPrefix(substr($functionString, 1));
    }
}

            'NETWORKDAYS' => true,

            'DATE' => true,
            'EDATE' => true,
            'EOMONTH' => true,

            'SORT' => true,
            'SORTBY' => true,
            'UNIQUE' => true,
            'SEQUENCE' => true,

            'XLOOKUP' => true,
            'XMATCH' => true,

                                        ++$scanIndex;
                                    } else {
                                        $inString = false;
                                        $scanValue = '';
                                    }
                                } else {
                                    $inString = false;
                                    $scanValue = '';
                                }
                            } else {
                                $scanValue .= $character;
                            }
                            ++$scanIndex;

                            continue;
                        }
                        if ($inPath) {
                            if ($character === \PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Calculation\FormulaParser::QUOTE_SINGLE) {
                                if (($scanIndex + 1) < $byteLength) {
                                    if ($preparedFormula[$scanIndex + 1] === \PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Calculation\FormulaParser::QUOTE_SINGLE) {
                                        $scanValue .= \PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Calculation\FormulaParser::QUOTE_SINGLE;
                                        ++$scanIndex;
                                    } else {
                                        $inPath = false;
                                    }
                                } else {
                                    $inPath = false;
                                }

                            continue;

                            continue;

                            $inString = true;

                            ++$scanIndex;

                            continue;

                            $inPath = true;
                            ++$scanIndex;

                            continue;
                        }

                            $inRange = true;
                            $scanValue .= $character;
                            ++$scanIndex;

                            $inError = true;

                            $scanValue = '';
                            ++$scanIndex;

                            continue;

                                $scannedFunctions[] = $scanValue;
                                $upperScan = \PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Shared\StringHelper::strToUpper($scanValue);
                                if (strpos($upperScan, '_XLWS.') !== false) {
                                    $hasWorksheetPrefixedFunction = true;
                                }
                                if (strpos($upperScan, '_XLFN.') !== false) {
                                    $hasWorksheetPrefixedFunction = true;
                                }
                            }

                            ++$parenDepth;
                            ++$scanIndex;

                            continue;
                        }
                        if ($character === \PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Calculation\FormulaParser::PAREN_CLOSE) {
                            $scanValue = '';
                            if ($parenDepth > 0) {
                                --$parenDepth;
                            }
                            ++$scanIndex;

                            continue;
                        }
                        if ($character === \PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Calculation\FormulaParser::COMMA) {
                            $scanValue = '';
                            ++$scanIndex;

                            continue;
                        }
                        if ($character === \PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Calculation\FormulaParser::BRACE_OPEN) {
                            $scanValue = '';
                            ++$scanIndex;

                            continue;
                        }
                        if ($character === \PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Calculation\FormulaParser::BRACE_CLOSE) {
                            $scanValue = '';
                            ++$scanIndex;

                            continue;
                        }
                        if ($character === \PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Calculation\FormulaParser::WHITESPACE) {
                            $scanValue = '';
                            ++$scanIndex;
                            while ($scanIndex < $byteLength) {
                                if ($preparedFormula[$scanIndex] !== \PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Calculation\FormulaParser::WHITESPACE) {

                                }
                                ++$scanIndex;
                            }

                            continue;
                        }
                        if (($scanIndex + 2) <= $byteLength) {
                            $pair = substr($preparedFormula, $scanIndex, 2);
                            if (in_array($pair, $comparatorTokens, true)) {

                            ++$scanIndex;

                            continue;

                            ++$scanIndex;

                            continue;

                            ++$scanIndex;

                            continue;

                        $scanValue = '';
                        ++$scanIndex;

                            if (isset($functionCatalog[$normalizedName]['category'])) {

                                $hasDateTimeFunction = true;
                                if (isset($dateFunctionNames[$normalizedName])) {
                                    if ($normalizedName === 'NETWORKDAYS') {
                                        $hasDateTimeFunction = true;
                                    } elseif ($normalizedName === 'DAYS') {
                                        $hasDateTimeFunction = true;
                                    } else {
                                        $hasLegacyFunction = true;
                                    }
                                }
                            } elseif ($category === 'Lookup and Reference') {
                                if (isset($dynamicFunctionNames[$normalizedName])) {
                                    $hasDynamicArrayFunction = true;
                                } else {
                                    $hasLegacyFunction = true;
                                }
                            } elseif ($category === 'Math and Trig') {
                                if (isset($legacyFunctionNames[$normalizedName])) {
                                    $hasLegacyFunction = true;
                                }
                            } elseif ($category === 'Logical') {
                                if (isset($legacyFunctionNames[$normalizedName])) {
                                    $hasLegacyFunction = true;
                                }
                            }
                        } else {
                            if (isset($dynamicFunctionNames[$normalizedName])) {
                                $hasDynamicArrayFunction = true;
                            } elseif (strpos($normalizedName, 'DAYS') !== false) {
                                $hasDateTimeFunction = true;
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    $prefixed = $preparedFormula;
                    $xlfnCount = preg_match_all(self::XLFNREGEXP, $prefixed, $xlfnCaptures, PREG_SET_ORDER | PREG_OFFSET_CAPTURE);
                    if ($xlfnCount) {
                        for ($xlfnIndex = $xlfnCount - 1; $xlfnIndex >= 0; --$xlfnIndex) {
                            if (isset($xlfnCaptures[$xlfnIndex][0][0], $xlfnCaptures[$xlfnIndex][0][1], $xlfnCaptures[$xlfnIndex][1][0])) {
                                $fullMatch = $xlfnCaptures[$xlfnIndex][0][0];
                                $fullOffset = (int) $xlfnCaptures[$xlfnIndex][0][1];
                                $innerName = $xlfnCaptures[$xlfnIndex][1][0];
                                $lookupName = \PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Shared\StringHelper::strToUpper($innerName);
                                $lookupName = str_replace('_XLWS.', '', $lookupName);

                                    if (isset($functionCatalog[$lookupName]['category'])) {
                                        $matchCategory = $functionCatalog[$lookupName]['category'];
                                    }
                                    if ($matchCategory === 'Date and Time') {
                                        $hasDateTimeFunction = true;
                                    } elseif ($matchCategory === 'Lookup and Reference') {
                                        $hasDynamicArrayFunction = true;
                                    } else {
                                        $hasLegacyFunction = $hasLegacyFunction || isset($legacyFunctionNames[$lookupName]);
                                    }
                                } elseif ($lookupName === 'DAYS') {
                                    $hasDateTimeFunction = true;
                                }
                                $replacement = '_xlfn.' . $innerName . '(';
                                if ($fullOffset >= 0) {
                                    if ($fullOffset <= strlen($prefixed)) {
                                        $prefixed = substr($prefixed, 0, $fullOffset) . $replacement . substr($prefixed, $fullOffset + strlen($fullMatch));
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }

                    $xlwsCount = preg_match_all(self::XLWSREGEXP, $prefixed, $xlwsCaptures, PREG_SET_ORDER | PREG_OFFSET_CAPTURE);

                                } elseif ($wsLookup === 'SORT') {
                                    $hasDynamicArrayFunction = true;
                                }
                                $wsReplacement = '_xlws.' . $wsInner . '(';
                                if ($wsOffset >= 0) {

                                    }
                                }
                            }

     */
    public static function addFunctionPrefixStripEquals(string $functionString): string
    {
        return self::addFunctionPrefix(substr($functionString, 1));
    }

part.text: The single error is unrelated (missing `imagejpeg`/GD extension in the container). Confirming the regex is used consistently elsewhere:

Fixed. The root cause was that the `XLFNREGEXP` in `src/PhpSpreadsheet/Writer/Xlsx/FunctionPrefix.php:7` lacked a word-boundary anchor, so the `days` alternative matched inside `NETWORKDAYS(` (and would also mis-match inside other longer names). Adding `\b` before the optional `_xlfn.` prefix fixes it for both code paths that use the regex.

Verified:
- `NETWORKDAYS(A1,A2)` → unchanged; `DAYS(A1,A2)` → `_xlfn.DAYS(A1,A2)`
- `FunctionPrefixTest` passes (13/13); full `Writer/Xlsx` suite passes except one pre-existing, unrelated error from a missing `imagejpeg` (GD) in the environment.
